dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body region toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and continuous with no localized bulges or indentations visible at the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Series of faint, dark, parallel vertical linear marks located on the posterior half of the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple healed vertical linear scars, consistent with rake marks, on the posterior dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined, high-contrast dark circular point representing the blowhole at the anterior extremity.
